bake.rationale: The bank already ships inside the generic BOB actor package. Emitting a second linked copy would cost 6,288 cart bytes for zero new capability, so the standalone .s64b is a host verification artifact only.

degradation.policy: phase plan section 2b -- author to the Saturn budget, do not port the N64 asset and then look for savings

geo_scale_folded.decision: GEO_SCALE(0x00, 24576) is folded into the baked joint translations at 0.375 and no runtime scale node is emitted
geo_scale_folded.evidence: source (0,57,-60) bakes to (0,21,-23); source (91,0,0) bakes to (34,0,0)
geo_scale_folded.visual_cost: sub-unit rounding on four joint offsets, fixed and non-accumulating
geo_scale_folded.saves: one matrix multiply per part per frame and one geo node class the runtime does not have to support

shadow_dropped.decision: GEO_SHADOW is recorded and not emitted as geometry
shadow_dropped.visual_cost: no per-actor shadow from this bank
shadow_dropped.replacement: W4 standing policy -- a generic painted sprite under the actor, not a light-following N64 shadow

switch_alternatives_share_one_joint.decision: the two geo_switch_anim_state display lists (eyes open / eyes blink) bind to ONE joint ordinal (12), matching the source animation stream's 13 channels
switch_alternatives_share_one_joint.visual_cost: none -- the source only ever draws one of the two

one_command_per_primitive.decision: one VDP1 command per source triangle; a textured primitive emits a distorted sprite and NOT an additional Gouraud polygon
one_command_per_primitive.contrast: T2.19a: Mario's 50 textured primitives emit a Gouraud polygon PLUS a distorted sprite, and 56.38% of their texture words are transparent
one_command_per_primitive.visual_cost: VDP1 textured Gouraud is additive rather than N64 texture-times-shade

texture_budget.quantizer: deterministic transparent-plus-15-colour median cut; CLUT index zero is transparent; alpha threshold 128

budget.max_joints_reason: complete_actor_joint_workspace is 20 Q16.16 matrices and is shared with the skinned lane; each extra part costs 64 B of HWRAM
budget.max_rigid_pose_bytes_reason: the large cold pose class (r2-rigid-part-evaluator.md section 1.4)
budget.max_primitives_reason: Mario is 644 primitives / 694 VDP1 commands and Z-Treme's whole-scene budget is 1,900 polys; 14 live Bob-ombs at 68 commands is already 952 commands, so this is the ceiling, not a target

animation_selection.rationale: The actor has exactly two source animations (walk, 25 frames; and a 10-frame secondary) and both are reachable from bhvBobomb. Mario's core-play-v1 tiering exists because 193 animation files had to be cut to 103; with two, tiering would cost more than it saves.
animation_selection.substitution: nearest-baked-animation-id, ties resolved to the lower ID -- unreachable because every ID is baked
